_hinweis: Vignetten für die Analyse «Visuelle Sprache der ganzen Bibel» (2026-11-21). Stationen der grossen Geschichte (Bibelebene) und Psalm 1 (Poesie mit Bildwort). Gott wird nie als Figur gemalt.

auftraege.bild_en: The creation: a calm landscape at its very beginning – still water, a first green shore with a few plants and trees, a few birds in the air and a few fish in the water. No people, no figure of God, no rays.

Abraham, an old man with a long grey beard in a simple brown robe, stands outside a single nomad tent at night and looks up at a sky full of small stars; a few sheep sleep beside the tent. The night sky is a pale blue-grey wash, the stars are tiny unpainted dots.

The Israelites – a long column of men, women and children with bundles and a few sheep – walk on dry ground through the sea, with a wall of blue-grey water on the left and on the right. Seen from the side, small figures.
David as a young shepherd: a youth of about sixteen with reddish-brown curly hair in a simple tunic, a shepherd's staff and a small harp (lyre), sitting on a rock among a few sheep on a hillside.

The exile: a small group of men, women and children with bundles walk away along a road towards a distant flat city with a stepped tower; behind them, far away, a city on a hill. Sad, quiet, dignified; no soldiers, no violence.

Early morning in a garden: a tomb cut into a rock with its large round stone rolled aside, the dark opening empty; folded linen cloth visible inside. A pale dawn wash, a few olive trees. No people, no light effects.

The first church: a small group of men and women of different ages and backgrounds sit together in a simple courtyard, breaking flat bread and sharing a cup, talking and listening; one older man holds a scroll. Warm and ordinary, no light effects.
The new creation: a clear river flows from a distant city of pale stone; on both banks stands the tree of life with leaves and fruit; a few people walk by the river. Calm, light, no glowing effects.
A single tree planted by a stream of water, with full green leaves and some ripe fruit hanging from its branches; its roots reach the water.
A threshing floor on a windy hill: a man tosses grain with a wooden winnowing fork; the light chaff blows away in the wind as a pale streak, while the heavier grain falls down onto a small heap.
